product_metadata.title: WarmZone Heat Reflective Blanket, Throw 50x70, Khaki
features: WARMZONE FABRIC: The blanket’s ultra-soft WarmZone fabric has a revolutionary thermo-conductive surface that stores and reflects the heat your own body generates. It warms 20% faster than a conventional blanket for pleasant continued warmth.

NO CORDS NEEDED: Unlike electric blankets, WarmZone blankets safely and efficiently heat and keep the body warm without any plugs or cords. The blanket uses FAR infrared technology for healthy warming.

SOFT COZY COMFORT: Luxuriously soft 100% polyester micro-Sherpa fabric adds extra comfort and the double-needle stitching adds durability. With several neutral colors to match your décor, this single blanket will keep you warm and cozy.

MAKES A GREAT GIFT: Know someone who is always cold? Give them the gift of warmth with a WarmZone micro-Sherpa blanket. Amazingly soft, cozy and comfortable, this blanket is great for keeping warm all year long.
description: It’s common knowledge that when you sleep better, you feel better. For those who struggle to get and stay warm at night, the WarmZone Micro-Sherpa Heat Reflective Blanket is the bedding you’ve been looking for. The blanket’s ultra-soft WarmZone fabric has a revolutionary thermo-conductive surface that stores and reflects the heat your own body generates to warm 20% faster than a conventional blanket for pleasant, long-lasting warmth. Unlike electric blankets that use electricity and are potential fire hazards, WarmZone blankets safely and efficiently heat and keep the body warm without any plugs or cords. The blanket uses FAR infrared technology for healthy warming.  Rather than being weighed down by a pile of blankets, this single throw-sized 50” x 70” blanket will keep you warm and cozy. Luxuriously soft 100% polyester micro-Sherpa fabric adds extra comfort and the double-needle stitching adds durability. Plus, it is machine washable and dryable for easy care. With several neutral colors to match your décor, you will want one on every bed in the house. Also makes a great gift!
